title: Meta Invests $9.1 Billion in Canadian AI Data Center
summary: Meta is investing $9.1 billion in a large AI data center in Canada, marking the company's first major global investment outside the US. The project is expected to create jobs and stimulate economic growth in the region. Meta's decision comes as the company continues to expand its presence in the tech industry.
summary_points: Meta is investing $9.1 billion in a Canadian AI data center
The center will be the largest outside the US
This marks Meta's first major global investment outside the US
The project aims to create jobs and stimulate economic growth
Meta's expansion into the tech industry continues
